title: 第5章 前往星斗，遭遇百万年天梦冰蚕与亡灵伊莱克斯
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

千仞雪见此就在一旁护法，直到鲸胶被彻底吸收了，亲眼看着霍雨浩气息变得更沉稳，体质也有了一点提升，千仞雪才满意地点头。

“既然吸收完毕了，走，我们去星斗大森林，为师帮你获取你的第一枚魂环去！”

“是！“

霍雨浩声音答应的很响亮，夹杂了不少的开心，脸上的笑容也变多了。

很难想象才过去了不到半天，他与初见时那副仇大苦深的样子差别就这么大。

但千仞雪喜欢这样的徒弟，所以对于他的一点点亲近之意呈默许态度，这孩子有点缺爱，若是一点点的师徒之爱能让他更加死心塌地，何乐而不为？

而霍雨浩呢，见老师一点不排斥自己的亲近，内心开心不已。

老师真的对他不一样，跟妈妈一样！

我又有家人了，妈妈，你见到了吗？

老师对我很好，你可以放心了！

霍雨浩一边跟上千仞雪的脚步，一边在心中美滋滋地与自己的母亲交谈。

看得千仞雪有些好笑，不过随即她又想起了霍雨浩的情况，笑容有些收敛。

“雨浩，你的武魂为灵眸，也就是眼睛，是精神系魂师，对吗？”

她若是没记错斗罗星意志给她的消息的话。

“是，而且还是属于本体武魂的一种，但由于先天魂力很低，连合适的武魂的魂兽据说都难找，所以白虎公爵府的人说我不值得培养。”

“精神系魂兽难找是难找了点，但不值得培养是他们目光短浅，别在意。至于你的先天魂力很低，据我刚才的观察，这不是你本来先天该有的魂力，若我猜的不错的话，你是不是在觉醒武魂前，一直处于长期营养不良的状态？”

“老师，您怎么知道的？”

霍雨浩的惊呼印证了千仞雪的猜测。

“那就是了，长期的营养不良，身体素质跟不上，你能觉醒高点的先天魂力才奇怪。不过从侧面来说，身体素质差还能有先天一级魂力，何尝不说明你的天赋很高，我倒是捡到宝了。”

千仞雪带着三分玩笑的口吻说道，可却又一次让霍雨浩脆弱的心灵被治愈的同时对于公爵夫人的仇恨也在增加。

他为何会营养不良都是因为公爵夫人对自己和妈妈的虐待！老师说了，若非如此，说不定他也能觉醒更高的先天魂力，然后被重视，妈妈也不会......

霍雨浩眼中的光芒慢慢熄灭，转而蒙上仇恨的阴霾，可就在他即将被仇恨吞没时，一只手落在了他的头上，给他带去了温暖。

“好了，总之一切都过去了，日后有为师保护你。对了，雨浩你恐高吗？”

“不啊，怎么了？”

“那就好。”

Page (1/3)

Seeing this, Qian Renxue stood aside to protect him. It was not until the whale glue was completely absorbed, and she saw with her own eyes that Huo Yuhao's aura became calmer and his physical condition improved a little, that Qian Renxue nodded with satisfaction.

"Now that the absorption is complete, let's go to the Star Dou Forest and help you get your first soul ring as master!"

"Yes!"

Huo Yuhao's voice was loud in agreement, mixed with a lot of happiness, and the smile on his face became more numerous.

It is hard to imagine that less than half a day has passed and he is so different from the angry and bitter look he had when they first met.

But Qian Renxue likes this kind of apprentice, so she acquiesces to his slightest affection. This child is a bit lacking in love. If a little love between master and apprentice can make him more devoted, why not?

As for Huo Yuhao, he was very happy to see that his teacher did not reject his approach at all.

The teacher really treats him differently, just like his mother!

I have a family again. Mom, have you seen it?

The teacher is very good to me, you can rest assured!

Huo Yuhao kept up with Qian Renxue while talking happily to his mother in his heart.

Qian Renxue looked a little funny, but then she thought of Huo Yuhao's situation, and her smile faded a little.

"Yuhao, your martial soul is the spiritual eye, which is the eye. You are a spiritual soul master, right?"

If she remembered correctly the message Douluo Xing Will gave her.

"Yes, and it is still a type of martial spirit. However, due to the low innate soul power, it is said that it is difficult to find a suitable spirit beast, so the people in the White Tiger Duke's Palace said that I am not worth cultivating."

"Spiritual soul beasts are difficult to find, but they are not worth cultivating because they are short-sighted. Don't worry about it. As for your innate soul power being very low, according to my observation just now, this is not the soul power you should have innately. If my guess is correct, have you been in a state of long-term malnutrition before awakening your martial soul?"

"Teacher, how did you know?"

Huo Yuhao's exclamation confirmed Qian Renxue's guess.

"That's it. You have been suffering from long-term malnutrition and your physical fitness cannot keep up. It's strange that you can awaken higher innate soul power. But from the side, you can still have first-level innate soul power with poor physical fitness. Doesn't it mean that your talent is very high? I have found a treasure."

Qian Renxue said in a joking tone, but once again Huo Yuhao's fragile mind was healed and his hatred for the duchess also increased.

The reason why he is malnourished is because of the abuse the Duchess treated himself and his mother!The teacher said that if this were not the case, maybe he could awaken a higher innate soul power and then be taken seriously, and his mother would not...

The light in Huo Yuhao's eyes slowly extinguished and turned to a haze of hatred. But just when he was about to be engulfed by hatred, a hand fell on his head, bringing him warmth.

"Okay, in short, everything is over. I will protect you as a teacher in the future. By the way, Yuhao, are you afraid of heights?"

"No, what's wrong?"

"That's good."
